summary: Pilot-only tuning: repeated nested CV of F-screen + RBF SVM, grid C×gamma×K
reasoning: Route method: pilot-fitted screen then RBF SVM. I reuse the snapshot's fully nested protocol (screen + K refit inside each outer fold, so no selection leakage) and swap the forest for StandardScaler+SVC(rbf) tuned over C∈[0.25..64]×γ∈[0.002..0.4]×K∈{10,25,50} with inner 4-fold GridSearchCV. cv_auc is the mean over 15 outer-fold AUCs (outer 5-fold, seeds 0,1,2), computed only on data/pilot.csv. This pilot-side honest estimate is my basis for freezing the procedure before the one-shot heldout scoring. Expectations: the tuning run exits cleanly, the estimate clears the floor 0.71, and the kept-feature count is within the route's cap of 50.
